obligations.title: Give Customer's security contact 24 hours' notice of any critical finding, describing the finding, affected systems and recommended mitigation.
Deliver the Baseline assessment report by 09 August 2026.
Deliver the Remediation roadmap by 18 October 2026.
Deliver the Retest and closure report by 06 April 2027.
Promptly notify Customer of an anticipated Milestone miss, with cause and recovery plan.
Hold regular engagement lead meetings to review progress, risks and issues.
Review each Deliverable and accept it in writing or notify material non-conformity within a reasonable period.
Promptly correct non-conformities and resubmit the Deliverable at no extra charge.
Deliver all completed and in-progress Deliverables on expiry or termination.
Notify Customer without undue delay on becoming aware of a personal data breach.
Return or securely delete Customer data on completion of the Services.
Protect findings, vulnerability details and Deliverables with appropriate technical and organisational safeguards.
